objective: Migrate VP-V4 to Next.js, React, strict TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS while applying the approved VisePanda product-preview copy.
issue: Direct operator instruction; no tracker issue.
scope: VisePanda text, aria, toast, metadata, and documentation
anti_goals: No real AI, account, Trip, booking, payment, Human Help, or persistence integration
decisions: Keep app/page.tsx as a Server Component and isolate interactions in components/VisePandaLanding.tsx.
Use next/font/local and next/image for existing local assets.
Use Tailwind v4 for foundations and tokens while retaining the existing fidelity CSS as a migration compatibility layer.
blockers: Reference-site images, video, logo, portraits, and fonts remain.
VisePanda production interfaces and backends are not connected.
Browser QA could not run because the managed sandbox rejects local port binding with EPERM and blocks file URLs by policy.
next_action: Run a separate asset, brand, and interface migration review before any public deployment.
